title.rendered: Canon Medical Systems UK– Royal Berkshire Hospital – Prime SP Bence Built Relocatable

content.rendered:
[vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1603238677945{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”][vc_column width=”2/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1603239058399{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1603238757464{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”]Very proud to work for Canon and closely with WH Bence to project manage this very high specification relocatable.

This unit was designed and built in record time. The entire project ran on time and on budget due to the focussed and diligent work of all the project stakeholders. The relocatable was designed carefully to optimise clinical workflow and to deliver  best in class patient experience, the unit benefitted from a change room, mood and ambient lighting, hydraulic legs, relax and view wall and ceiling LED images, a dedicated kitchenette, onboard telematics for remote monitoring of all plant, remote monitoring of the CT via Canon, an onboard generator, music system, switchable privacy glass, LED dimmable lighting and much more.

The system from Canon, consisted of a Cardiac enabled Canon Aquilion Prime SP 160 slice CT, lateral slide, UPS, in room fluoroscopy and much more.

The customer at Royal Berkshire Hospital, was delighted with the end product. It was a real privilege to be appointed the role of Project manager for this prestigious project.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1603238789184{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1603238746562{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”]Details
